name: Patti (Italy)
description: Vertical bicolour of blue and white, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Patti (a brown eagle bearing a shield) with the motto on a ribbon above and S.P.Q.P. beneath.
history: Municipal flag of Patti, a comune in Sicily; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Patti arms — brown eagle bearing a shield, with motto ribbon and S.P.Q.P.
